jobs.description: About the Role Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to join the Power & Utilization Management and Planning (PUMP) team within AWS Infrastructure Services. This role is responsible for driving programs that maximize power capacity, improve position planning accuracy, and accelerate rack deployment across AWS's global fleet of data centers. What You'll Do As a TIPM on the PUMP team, you will own sub-workstreams within one or more of the following program areas, working under the guidance of senior TIPMs who hold end-to-end accountability. You will drive execution on defined scopes, remove blockers, coordinate across partner teams, and progressively take on broader ownership as you build domain expertise. Data Center Position Configuration & Automation The Soapstone workflow produces three interdependent datasets per build — rack placement on the floor plan, power circuit-to-rack mapping (which determines what whips get physically installed), and network cabling plans (which determine how server racks connect to aggregation racks). These outputs determine what gets physically built: general contractors install whips from them, electrical engineers configure three-phase power equipment at the rack level, and mechanical engineers reference them for downstream work. When this workflow is delayed or incorrect, construction stalls, hardware ships to positions that cannot support it, and capacity delivery slips. You will own sub-workstreams within this pipeline — for example, driving configuration for a set of availability zones, managing the intake and validation process through SLATE (the team's build coordination portal), or accelerating Hamlet automation coverage to new building classes (COLO sites, hybrid floor plans, Room 1 configurations). Power Reclamation & Infrastructure Upgrades You will drive specific remediation campaigns that recover stranded power across legacy data centers through electrical upgrades, PDC (Power Distribution Cabinet) deployments, cooling improvements, and breaker-level optimizations. The power distribution landscape is complex: four distinct PDC versions are active in the fleet with different breaker counts and ampacity ratings, whip counts range from 18 to 26 per rack depending on product type, and whip lengths are tracked manually in Excel files rather than any system of record. You will coordinate across Field Remediation Engineering (FRE), Construction Project Implementation (CPI), Colocation Regional Engineering (CRE), and equipment procurement teams to execute physical infrastructure changes on time. Network & Server Position Planning You will own sub-workstreams that improve how network and server positions are planned, allocated, and made ready for deployment. A key challenge is that every rack product connects to the network differently — connection protocols vary (RoCE vs. EFA), server-to-switch ratios vary (3:1, 2:1, 1:1), and switch rack generations keep evolving (12.8T, 51.2T, 102.4T Ultra). You will work with Fulfillment Planning (FP), Capacity Delivery Planning (CDP), and Global Network Deployment (GND) on initiatives like the Fungible Network program, which deploys a standard product-agnostic network footprint per ROMP so that product flips no longer require cabling rework. You will use and improve tools like RATS and PRP to increase allocation rates and reduce rejection rates at scale. Power Data Modeling & Metrics You will contribute to the development and maintenance of power-related data models, dashboards, and sources of truth that inform executive-level decisions on capacity investment, utilization targets, and demand planning. This includes working with data engineering and BI teams to build QuickSight dashboards, validate Power SOT (Source of Truth) data, and support Monthly and Weekly Business Reviews. Utility Power Management You will support programs that optimize utility power utilization to meet contractual obligations and avoid financial penalties. This includes monitoring site-level deployed load against contracted capacity, identifying sites at risk of under-utilization, and coordinating with energy and operations teams to improve utilization rates. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management You will work daily with 10+ partner organizations including CDP, CRE, CPI, FRE, DCEO, GND, Hardware Engineering, ML Planning, AISS Science, and Networking. Success in this role requires the ability to influence without authority, drive accountability across organizational boundaries, and escalate effectively when blockers arise. About the team The PUMP team sits at the intersection of data center engineering, supply chain operations, and capacity planning. We own the end-to-end lifecycle of how power is planned, configured, allocated, and utilized across thousands of lineups, hundreds of data centers, and dozens of clusters worldwide. Our decisions directly impact AWS's ability to deliver compute, storage, and machine learning capacity to customers — from core EC2 workloads to the latest GPU-accelerated ML platforms like GB300, VR200, and TRN3Max.

jobs.description: At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates. In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: - Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy. - Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies. - Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies. - Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives. - Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. - Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest. - Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site. - Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations. - Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent. - Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site. - Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction. - Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures). - Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy - Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training. - Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement. - Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards. Additional Job Elements include: - Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach - Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts - Work in an environment where the noise level varies - Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments) - Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs) - Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: Intel Corporation is a global technology leader and one of the world's largest and most innovative semiconductor companies. For more than five decades, Intel has been at the forefront of designing and manufacturing the advanced chips, platforms, and technologies that power the modern world — from artificial intelligence and cloud computing to autonomous vehicles, 5G connectivity, and next-generation personal computing. With a bold vision for the future of semiconductor manufacturing, Intel is investing heavily in its U.S. fabrication capabilities — and our Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona is central to that vision. Home to four of Intel's most advanced fabrication facilities — Fab 12, Fab 32, Fab 42, and Fab 52 — the Ocotillo campus is where cutting-edge process technology meets world-class manufacturing execution. It is one of the most technologically sophisticated semiconductor manufacturing sites in the United States and a cornerstone of Intel's commitment to domestic chip production. At Intel, we know that our people are the driving force behind every breakthrough. We are deeply committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative workplace — one where every team member is valued, supported, and empowered to grow their career while contributing to technology that genuinely changes the world. Intel's Ocotillo campus is seeking a skilled, driven, and technically minded professional to join our Dedicated Emergency Response Team (DERT) as a Module Equipment Technician. The DERT is an elite team of specialized technicians embedded within Intel's advanced fabrication facilities. Unlike standard maintenance roles, DERT technicians function as first responders for critical equipment events — mobilizing rapidly when tools go down, diagnosing complex failures under pressure, and restoring production with precision and urgency. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of technical expertise, problem-solving, and operational excellence. In this position, you will maintain and troubleshoot some of the most sophisticated semiconductor manufacturing equipment in the world, working side by side with Intel's world-class engineering teams across Fab 12, Fab 32, Fab 42, and Fab 52. Every shift you work contributes directly to the production of Intel's most advanced chips — the technology that powers billions of devices and drives progress across every major industry on the planet. This role operates on a Compressed Work Week (CWW) schedule, featuring 12-hour shifts that provide extended consecutive days off — giving you more flexibility, better work-life balance, and more time for the things that matter most to you outside of work. Whether you are an experienced semiconductor technician, a skilled equipment maintenance professional from a related high-tech industry, or a military veteran with hands-on technical training, this is an exceptional opportunity to build a long-term career at one of the world's most respected technology companies. Key Responsibilities Emergency Equipment Response: Act as a frontline first responder for critical equipment failures across Intel's Ocotillo fabrication facilities, rapidly assessing situations, diagnosing root causes, and implementing effective corrective actions to restore production with minimal downtime and yield impact. Preventative & Corrective Maintenance: Execute scheduled preventative maintenance (PM) programs and perform corrective maintenance (CM) on advanced 300mm semiconductor manufacturing equipment, ensuring tools operate consistently within defined process specifications and performance targets. Wafer Production Operations Support: Actively support all phases of wafer fabrication — including equipment operation, process step execution, and cross-functional training — to meet and exceed fab production objectives across advanced node manufacturing. Equipment Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Apply systematic diagnostic techniques and analytical problem-solving skills to identify the root causes of equipment malfunctions, process deviations, and yield excursions, driving sustainable corrective actions that prevent recurrence. Defect Reduction & Yield Improvement: Identify, analyze, and address sources of equipment-related defects and process variability, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, process consistency, and overall fab performance. Technical Documentation & Schematic Interpretation: Work proficiently from technical manuals, engineering specifications, schematics, wiring diagrams, and complex engineering drawings, utilizing a broad range of tools and test equipment to perform maintenance and troubleshooting tasks with accuracy and safety. Specification & Procedure Development: Collaborate closely with process engineers and equipment engineers to influence the creation, revision, and improvement of maintenance specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and business processes that drive operational excellence across the fab. Cross-Functional Team Collaboration: Partner effectively with engineering teams, fellow technicians, and operations leadership to communicate equipment status, share technical insights, escalate issues appropriately, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning, safety, and high performance. Process Control System Monitoring: Utilize process control systems to monitor equipment performance, identify deviations from baseline parameters, and take proactive steps to maintain process stability and product quality. Skills to work well in a diverse team environment and multitask. Skills to work with minimal supervision and adjust to rapidly changing priorities. Skills to produce results in a timely manner. jobs.description: Global Optimization is a strategic initiative aimed at improving Amazon advertisers experience at global scale. We are looking for a passionate Applied Scientist to help pioneer the next generation of agentic AI applications for Amazon advertisers. In this role, you will design agentic architectures, develop tools and datasets, and contribute to building systems that can reason, plan, and act autonomously across complex advertiser workflows at global scale. You will work at the forefront of applied AI, developing methods for fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and preference optimization, while helping create evaluation frameworks that ensure safety, reliability, and trust at scale. You will work backwards from the needs of advertisers—delivering customer-facing products that directly help them create, optimize, and grow their campaigns. Beyond building models, you will advance the agent ecosystem by experimenting with and applying core primitives such as tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning, and adaptive preference-driven behavior. This role requires working independently on ambiguous technical problems, collaborating closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers to bring innovative solutions into production. Key job responsibilities - Design and build agents that improve advertisers experiences globally - Design and implement advanced model and agent optimization techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, instruction tuning and preference optimization (e.g., DPO/IPO). - Design and implement optimization models that work at global scale taking into account nuances of multiple countries - Innovate new science models to help advertisers scale their campaigns globally - Curate datasets and tools for MCP. - Build evaluation pipelines for agent workflows, including automated benchmarks, multi-step reasoning tests, and safety guardrails. - Develop agentic architectures (e.g., CoT, ToT, ReAct) that integrate planning, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning. - Prototype and iterate on multi-agent orchestration frameworks and workflows. - Collaborate with peers across engineering and product to bring scientific innovations into production. - Stay current with the latest research in LLMs, RL, and agent-based AI, optimization and translate findings into practical applications. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through the latest generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. The Global Optimization team within Sponsored Products and Brands is focused on guiding and supporting 1.6MM advertisers to meet their advertising needs of creating and managing ad campaigns at global scale. At this scale, the complexity of diverse advertiser goals, campaign types, and market dynamics creates both a massive technical challenge and a transformative opportunity: even small improvements in guidance systems can have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon’s retail ecosystem. Our work is grounded in state-of-the-art agent architectures, tool integration, reasoning frameworks, and model customization approaches (including tuning, MCP, and preference optimization), ensuring our systems are both scalable and adaptive.

jobs.description: Un univers d’opportunités chez Amazon Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Associate Director, Medical Science Liaison Purpose: Scientific and Clinical Experts (SEs/CEs) are individuals who are noted for their expertise in a therapeutic area and as a result have special needs for in-depth and cutting-edge scientific information, because they treat patients, design and implement novel research, and educate colleagues and students. The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) program is specifically designed to meet these needs through a field-based group of medical professionals with deep content knowledge about specific disease states, Lilly and competitive compounds and landscape in their respective therapeutic areas. MSLs recognize and communicate feedback and insights of strategic importance from their interactions with SEs and CEs, to better inform Lilly’s strategic direction for research, development, and commercialization. By facilitating scientific exchange between industry and the scientific and clinical communities, MSLs shape the future of healthcare by providing the required information that addresses important clinical and scientific questions. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervisor regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position. Scientific & clinical knowledge An MSL’s objective is to provide leading researchers and practitioners with the scientific and clinical knowledge that is most meaningfully and precisely addresses their needs (e.g., addressing clinical care gaps for their patients, clarifying nuanced clinical or research questions). This role requires efficient and precise synthesis of the latest research on products, disease states and standard of care for specific indications and therapeutic areas (TAs). Such a skillset and the underlying depth of expertise is typically acquired through substantial research experience or clinical training and requires continuous learning to maintain the highest level of technical expertise within a given TA. This continuous learning will enable the MSLs engagement in scientific exchange to respond to the diverse medical information needs based on customer requests. As a result, the MSL will establish themself as a reliable, trusted, resource of unbiased, accurate, up-to-date, medical and scientific information. Full spectrum SE/CE support Through the application of emotional intelligence, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of HCP needs, MSLs will act as one of the primary interfaces between Lilly Medical and SEs/CEs to deliver a positive experience and utilize MSL capabilities to support HCPs in sharing evidence and addressing clinical care gaps for improved patient outcomes. MSL will effectively utilize territory analytics for customer identification and routing prioritization. Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview
The EHS Compliance team is a group of top-tier experts dedicated to establishing and operating a legal, exemplary, and sustainable safety framework across all company operations. As part of this team, the Construction Safety compliance unit provides independent assurance and oversight on all construction, engineering, and facility modification activities. We proactively identify risks, monitor compliance performance, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver strategic, practical solutions that raise the company's overall safety standard.
What You Will Do
Conduct regular and ad-hoc on-site audits of construction activities to identify technical and operational risk factors based on site-specific characteristics. Produce comprehensive audit reports to clearly articulate identified risks and impact to leadership.
Build and maintain a robust compliance monitoring system for construction safety across all sites. Spearhead efforts to track, assess, and interpret applicable local construction safety laws, regulations, and technical standards, ensuring timely communication and operational alignment with internal stakeholders.
Regularly track construction safety KPIs and lead remediation efforts for escalated construction risks. Collaborate directly with project managers, general contractors, and engineering teams to implement innovative, best-practice solutions for identified compliance gaps.
Leverage creativity, strong planning capability, and technical knowledge to streamline safety compliance processes. Elevate the company's baseline construction safety performance by driving a proactive safety culture and establishing preventive standards for continuous improvement.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil/Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Occupational Health and Safety, or related engineering fields.
Approximately 8–10+ years of dedicated work experience in construction safety management, EHS compliance, or site safety auditing for large-scale engineering/facility projects.
Preferred Qualifications
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Chinese and English (capable of producing professional technical/audit reports in both languages).
Professional certifications in Construction Safety or Industrial Safety (e.g., Professional Industrial Safety Engineer /
甲級職業安全管理師/衛級證照, Certified Safety Professional (CSP), or equivalent national engineering licenses).
Multi-disciplinary inspection capabilities, including knowledge in industrial safety, structural fire protection, and heavy equipment/scaffolding safety standards.
Proficient in data management tools (e.g., MS Office Suite, Excel) for KPI analytics and risk dashboard presentation.

Job Description The Press Operator is responsible for the operation, troubleshooting, maintenance, cleanliness, and safety of the automatic cycle hydraulic transfer presses supporting production on any given production line. The Press Operator position is a key production role on lines utilizing transfer drawn cans. Knowledge of quality, attention to detail, and emphasis on maintenance are essential elements to a successful job performance. Inspect for scratches, draw marks, pin holes, bites in flanges, bulges, and any other non-conformities. · Perform SPC data checks on an hourly basis. Each Operator should be able to calibrate and use all necessary gauges, including dial indicators, micrometers, and various go/no go gauges. · Change/replace finishing press punches or bushings in addition to trimmer on transfer as well as repair broken bolts and minor oil leaks. · Report all nonconformities to the Quality Department and Shift Supervisor immediately. · Understand and operate control panels appropriately. · Operate and maintain D&I unit, trimmer/flanger, and finishing press in addition to repairing and replacing D&I ironing cap, sleeve, and pressure rings. · Adjust the chain and position of pockets in line with finish press tooling in addition to shim pressure rings, line up caps, and other tooling as required. · Assist Maintenance and Tooling Departments during heavy maintenance and changeovers. · Support the replacement of hydraulic cylinders, pumps, air cushions, couplings, platens, bushings, pins, etc. · Replace or repair conveyor belts and prime your hydraulic pumps when needed. · Troubleshoot draw marks and other surface (inside and outside) imperfections in addition to trimmer/flanger, ironer, and finishing press. · Operate transfer presses on other lines as needed and transfer ones own tools when moved. · Complete all required documentation accurately and completely Qualifications High School Diploma/GED or equivalent required. jobs.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT NORTH North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. WHY THIS ROLE? This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. We’re looking for senior software engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one. Experience and Leadership - Experience working directly with customers or stakeholders to design and deliver LLM-powered agentic solutions aligned with real business needs. - Proven technical leadership at the team level, including guiding architecture, implementation, and delivery of complex AI systems. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Fluency in English and Korean language. IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE: - Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams - Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it - Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms) - Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ROLE SUMMARY As a GRC Engineer, you will be at the heart of Mistral’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program. You will design, implement, and maintain the technical and operational frameworks that ensure our organization meets its regulatory, security, and risk management obligations. Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to automate compliance processes, monitor risks, and enforce governance policies. You will play a key role in ensuring that our systems, processes, and controls align with industry standards and regulatory requirements. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Automate GRC workflows: Design, develop, and deploy automation scripts and tools to streamline compliance monitoring, evidence collection, risk assessments, and control testing. - Integrate GRC tools with existing systems: Build and maintain integrations between GRC platforms and other enterprise systems (e.g., SIEM, IAM, or ticketing tools) to enable real-time risk and compliance monitoring. - Develop custom dashboards and reports: Create automated dashboards to provide real-time visibility into compliance status, risk exposure, and control effectiveness for stakeholders. - Automate control testing and validation: Implement automated control testing for technical controls (e.g., access reviews, patch management, or configuration compliance) to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy. - Enforce policy-as-code: Embed compliance and security policies directly into cloud and on-premise environments, ensuring consistent enforcement across systems. - Automate risk assessments: Develop workflows to automate the identification and prioritization of risks, such as integrating vulnerability scanning tools with GRC platforms to flag high-risk assets automatically. - Streamline audit evidence collection: Automate the gathering and organization of audit evidence (e.g., logs, configuration files, or access records) to support internal and external audits, reducing preparation time and minimizing errors. - Implement continuous compliance monitoring: Set up automated alerts and triggers for non-compliance events (e.g., unauthorized access, misconfigurations, or policy violations) - Automate third-party risk management: Build workflows to automate vendor risk assessments, including sending questionnaires, scoring responses, and escalating high-risk vendors for review. - Enhance incident response with automation: Collaborate with Security teams to automate incident response processes, such as triggering remediation workflows for identified risks or compliance gaps. - Maintain and optimize GRC tools: Continuously improve GRC platforms by automating routine tasks (e.g., user access reviews, control attestations) and enhancing their scalability and performance. ABOUT YOU - 5+ years in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), IT audit, cybersecurity, or a related field. - Hands-on experience with GRC tools. - Deep knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, COBIT, or regulatory requirements like GDPR, NIS2, or HIPAA. - Proficiency in scripting and automation to streamline GRC processes. - Strong understanding of IT controls, risk assessment methodologies, and security best practices. - Experience with SIEM, IAM, or vulnerability management tools. - Familiarity with cloud security and compliance (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP security controls). - Ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and develop actionable insights. - Creative and pragmatic approach to addressing GRC challenges. - Rigor in managing documentation, controls, and compliance evidence. - Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, Security, Legal, and Business units. - Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice-versa - Professional proficiency in English; French proficiency is a plus.. - Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
TEAM OVERVIEW
KKR’s Global Operations team enables the firm’s businesses by supporting the lifecycles of our investments, investors, and funds from one global operating platform. Leveraging a data-driven approach, the team’s operating verticals align with our businesses to ensure that we are able to provide best in class service to internal and external stakeholders while using technology, process, and location as tools to adapt and scale. The business area is comprised of the Client Services, Treasury, Private Market Operations, Data Operations, and Global Credit Investment Operations teams.
POSITION SUMMARY
KKR has an enterprise data operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. Given the criticality of Portfolio Company (PortCo) data to KKR’s Private Markets business, a dedicated Portfolio Company Data Operations function has been established to service our Private Equity and Infrastructure businesses. Structured within the broader Global Data Operations organization, this team is tasked with ensuring all Portfolio Company financials are controlled, consumable, and curated to deliver transparent & impactful insights to key internal & external constituents.
The PortCo Data Operations team is seeking to hire an Associate based in Boston, MA to support Americas Private Equity data management and performance reporting/analysis efforts. The candidate will work closely with Private Equity deal teams, KKR Capstone, and KKR Capital Markets teams to lead the KKR internal portfolio monitoring process and associated technology platform. While driving continuous transformation & improvement, this role will also assist with the execution of the on-going processes of Portfolio Company on-boarding, data quality management, and analytics to meet the evolving needs of both regional & global leadership.
This position will report to the Americas Lead, Portfolio Company Data Operations. The ideal candidate would have the unique combination of financial acumen, strong data analysis & technical skills, and a passion/interest in private markets investing. The candidate should also have an interest in embracing new technologies (AI), have strong verbal/written communication skills, and be a good cultural fit with an emphasis on collaboration, excellence, and action-oriented results.
KKR has a very collaborative culture where an individual’s success is the result of both acumen in the role and ability to leverage the whole firm. They think in terms of “we”, not “I” and know we are better together than one single person. One firm, collaboration, operating with “like and trust” are core to how KKR operates. The person who joins in this role is joining the Portfolio Company Data Operations team but also a team of 2,500 people across the firm and we all work together to support each other in delivering the best of KKR to our companies and clients.
RESPONSIBLITIES
Maintain and analyze Americas Private Equity portfolio company financial data, ensuring end-to-end data integrity and a unified source of truth throughout the company lifecycle—including onboarding, operational monitoring, and exit analysis.
Manage the recurring financial data collection efforts for Americas Private Equity, ensuring that data is clean and accurate and operational processes are high quality and repeatable.
Develop and maintain data products, complex SQL and data transformation logic, AI skills and agents, and lightweight software solutions that automate financial analysis and operational workflows.
Produce quarterly performance reporting and analytics across strategies, working closely with deal teams to synthesize financial and operational data to produce actionable insights for portfolio management committees and senior leadership.
Monitor data quality controls to ensure PortCo data completeness & accuracy, helping with the processing of any / all corrective maintenance required to remediate identified data issues in a timely manner.
Operate the internal data platform (Chronograph) within the region, resolving technical and data-related inquiries and leveraging platform to optimize user experience and engagement.
Provide a best-in-class client data experience by producing quarterly LP reports, managing ad hoc data requests, and addressing due diligence queries in collaboration with KKR’s Client Services team.
Act as a trusted resource for data-related questions and updates from various internal and external groups, such as PortCo contacts and deal teams.
Collaborate with the Global Data Operations team, to provide flexible support to all data initiatives and global functions, as necessary.
Collaborate with regional team members across offices and time zones in support of these initiatives.
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or related quantitative discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
4-6 years of experience in a data-intensive role within financial services, private equity, asset management, or a comparable institutional environment.
Intermediate SQL skills to manipulate data (experience with joins, unions, views, etc.).
Familiarity with Python or a similar programming language.
Understanding of financial statement analysis, corporate finance, and the private equity ecosystem.
Hands-on experience using data visualization tools such as Sigma, PowerBI, Tableau, or similar tools to support analyses.
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Excel plug ins, Power Query).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill data into insights.
Strong cultural fit – collaborative, intellectually curious, action-oriented, and committed to high standards of excellence and accountability.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment, including ability to be detail-oriented across multiple competing priorities.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Buy-side exposure with experience in asset/ investment management.
Data analytics & modeling skills using Python, R, etc.
Experience with cloud data warehouse solutions such as Snowflake, Databricks, etc.
Experience with Private Equity Portfolio Monitoring tools such as Chronograph, iLEVEL, Cobalt, etc.
Knowledge of Private Markets / Private Company data, trends and analytics.
Familiarity with market & alternative data vendors.
